purpose: Preferred policy-facing predictive specification for prospective poverty entry and exit benchmarking.

rationale.demographics: Repeated ablation improved predictive metrics after removal; retain only for subgroup auditing.
rationale.assets: Repeated ablation showed negligible incremental performance; exclude to simplify the model.
rationale.retained: Income, employment, education, housing, and safety-net variables retained because ablation indicates meaningful prospective signal.

safeguards: FINYR2-weighted model fitting and sensitivity evaluation
preprocessing fit within training data only
predictions are not causal estimates or automated eligibility decisions
